name: Textile Crafts of the World
subtitle: Nanduti, Songket & more
shortDescription: 17 craft traditions to play: Nanduti, Sashiko stitch patterns, Batik pattern studio and Songket gold weaving.
longDescription:
Textile Crafts of the World: 17 craft traditions from 22 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Nanduti, Sashiko stitch patterns, Batik pattern studio, Songket gold weaving, Celtic knot weave, Cross-stitch pattern weaving, Nordic colourwork yoke, Tartan sett weaving, Persian carpet knotting, Tatreez Palestinian Cross-Stitch, Ikat pattern dyeing, Dhaka weave pattern loom, Suzani Embroidery, Phulkari Darn-Stitch Embroidery, Kente strip weaving, Adire indigo resist dyeing and Malagasy lamba silk weaving.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can build traditional patterns, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
